title: ライバルのあの子～どんな舞台でも～

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Mejiro McQueen tells me she wants to practice for her concerts, so I head to my office to talk to her about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Is that new racewear you're wearing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. I was given this new signature racewear in recognition of my efforts.
choice_data_list: Is that what made you want to rehearse?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Of course, that is a factor. However…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: As I'm sure you're aware… I wasn't the only one to receive a new outfit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's true. Tokai Teio did also recently receive new signature racewear as a reward for her efforts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Her dance moves are unrivaled.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Which means that I must not allow her to outshine me when we are side by side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I need to live up to the honor of my racewear and the support of my fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The strength of her sense of duty is apparent. We immediately make our way to the stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, who might that be?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There is already someone on the stage. It's Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: How are you all doing out there? Feeling good? 'Cause I'm just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us watch her perform, spellbound by the bounce in her step and her energetic smile.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Ah, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, what gives? You shoulda told me you were here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh… I apologize. I was just a little taken aback, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It seems we had the same idea after receiving our new racewear.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, that's true! Once I got this, I started thinking about being number one, even on stage!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You know, your new signature racewear suits you and all, but…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: My racewear is the coolest! I'm gonna be the hottest thing out there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well, we shall see about that. I won't be losing to anyone… neither on the track nor the stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio eventually finishes her rehearsal and leaves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen stares at Tokai Teio as she walks away with an intensity in her eyes that I've never seen before.
choice_data_list: I can see you really respect her.
I can see you really respect her.
Don't worry about her. You have your own unique strengths.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Yes, I do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It doesn't end at those dance moves we saw either. Her cheerful demeanor, how she is quick to take initiative…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And that unbreakable drive… I have a lot to learn from her.
choice_data_list: We'll keep working hard to make sure you don't fall behind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Of course. After all, I swore that I wouldn't lose on the track or the stage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now, observe my footwork, please. I promise to show you a dance so graceful that others pale in comparison.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She dances on the stage, fueled by a competitive drive. True to her words, her dance is replete with an unparalleled elegance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You think so? Hehe, I am pleased to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now then, where in particular do you think my strengths lie?
choice_data_list: In your graceful composure and your stoic nature…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I see.
choice_data_list: And your extreme sense of responsibility, which can be worrying at times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hmph. It sounded nice until that last part. Do you consider that to be a compliment?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well… I concede. I cannot deny that I may worry you at times.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I watch her rehearse afterwards. Whenever I see her overthinking her moves, we stop and take a break.
